name: io.github.Invarato/jarroba-tools-logs
description: Lets your AI read a CI log far too big for its context. 11 tools, takes a file path.

environmentVariables.description: Which tool domains to publish, comma-separated. Defaults to what this package is for. Valid: core, calc, diagram, kg, db, ai, logs, queue, project, tests, api, chip, chem, access, archsim, security, experiments. Fewer domains means less of your context window spent on tool definitions.
environmentVariables.name: JARROBA_MCP_DOMAINS

title: Jarroba Tools · Logs
